verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no specifics on PCIe generation/lane counts, storage interface support, or external connectivity (USB/Thunderbolt) specs for the 285K platform — only marketing copy, memory/vPro/ECC details, and Linux/Windows performance reports. This axis clearly applies to a desktop CPU/platform story, but no documentation of I/O headroom is present, so it cannot be credited. Missing for 10: PCIe lane/generation breakdown, storage (M.2/NVMe) specs, USB/Thunderbolt connectivity details, chipset I/O documentation.
